aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for a ~4% monthly return. It leans into leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. Be aware this approach significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

income.read: This income plan focuses on parking cash for yield, targeting a ~1% monthly return. It prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
